tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Find hotels in a city for given dates and guests, with live prices for booking directly with the hotel (no OTA markup). Use this whenever someone wants a place to stay, compares hotels, or asks about hotel prices or availability for specific dates. Each hotel comes with a hotel_id.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: List every available room and rate at one hotel for given dates: total price, meals, cancellation terms and a link to book direct with the hotel. Takes a hotel_id.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Description, amenities, photos, address and check-in/check-out times for one hotel.
